name: Decide from Trac data via the Trac MCP
query: Should I work on Trac ticket #66277?
expected_behavior: Use the WordPress Trac MCP getTicket (or trac.mjs fallback) with comments, keywords, linked PRs and changesets
Check linked changesets with getChangeset and duplicates with searchTickets
Give a verdict with its basis and numbered options with one recommendation
Make no code changes before the user chooses
success_criteria: Cites concrete ticket evidence (comments, keywords, changeset numbers)
States whether the verdict comes from code reading or reproduction
Recommends leaving it when the ticket is fixed or heading for closure
